description: Qwen2.5-Coder is Alibaba's code-specialized LLM family built on Qwen2.5. It offers state-of-the-art code generation capabilities with sizes from 0.5B to 32B parameters and supports 92+ programming languages.

trainingData.description: Built on Qwen2.5 with extensive code training data. Supports 92+ programming languages.

trainingProcedure: Continued pre-training on code data from Qwen2.5 base, followed by instruction tuning.

evaluation.performanceSummary: State-of-the-art open code model. Qwen2.5-Coder-32B competitive with GPT-4 on code benchmarks.

knownLimitations: May generate code with bugs or security vulnerabilities
Knowledge limited to training data cutoff

ethicalConsiderations.biasAndFairness: May reflect biases in code training data.
ethicalConsiderations.safetyMeasures: Instruct variants have safety tuning applied.
ethicalConsiderations.privacyConsiderations: Open weights allow local deployment for sensitive code.
